mission.assigneeNotAllowed: This person cannot open the Aldaron workspace: give the mission to a member of the team.
mission.clientNotActive: This client is archived or anonymized: put it back in the list before giving it a mission.
mission.endBeforeStart: The end date of a mission cannot come before its start date.
mission.partiesFrozen: A mission that is {{status}} keeps its client and its quote: only a planned mission can change them.
mission.phaseNotAllowed: The phase "{{phase}}" does not belong to a mission that is {{status}}.
mission.quoteNotFound: The quote of the mission was not found.
mission.quoteNotLinkable: Quote {{number}} cannot be the one of this mission: only an accepted quote of the same client can.
mission.statusChangeNotAllowed: A mission that is {{from}} cannot become {{to}}.
